Supply $50 of USDC to Vena Finance on Fluent and keep the position open Cost: $50 of capital and about $0.50 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Repay a small part of the borrow on Vena Finance and re-supply it, so the week shows a fresh action Cost: about $0.50 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 60 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.
Watch Vena Finance’s own announcements and points page for a program; if one opens, finish its first task the same week it appears Cost: nothing but the watch. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Before you withdraw, open Vena Finance’s own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes: never pay to claim, and never trust a claim link from a chat, a search ad or a DM Cost: no fee to check. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction for Vena Finance (rank #190) in a farm log, so you can repeat the position or unwind it Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
